hero.subtitle: SuperStock, the modern solution to track your products, movements and inventories in real time.

features.title: Everything you need to run your stock
features.subtitle: Six modules designed for the daily work of a supermarket.

products.title: Product management
products.text: A catalog organized by categories, with sale units, alert thresholds and automatically generated references.

movements.title: Stock movements
movements.text: Every entry and every exit is tracked. A mistake is fixed with a reverse movement: nothing is ever erased.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.text: Count the real stock, see the gaps and validate: stock corrections are created for you.

alerts.title: Low stock alerts
alerts.text: Spot at a glance the products below their threshold, from the most to the least critical.

roles.title: Roles and security
roles.text: Owner, manager, administrator: everyone only accesses what they need.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.text: A dashboard with key figures and charts on entries, exits and categories.

how.title: How it works
how.subtitle: Three steps to take control of your stock.

one.title: Organize your catalog
one.text: Create your categories and products with their unit and alert threshold.

two.title: Record your movements
two.text: Every entry and every exit updates the stock automatically.

three.title: Stay in control in real time
three.text: Follow alerts and the dashboard, and run an inventory whenever you want.

about.title: About
about.text: SuperStock is a stock management project built with React, NestJS and PostgreSQL. It meets the needs of a large supermarket: tracking every product, every entry and every exit, without ever losing the history.

contact.title: Contact
contact.text: A question or a demo? Write to us.

cta.title: Ready to optimize your management?
cta.subtitle: Sign in and take back control of your stock.
